bedrock.line: That's toxic clear down to the bedrock
stanza: This song is for the soil
That's toxic clear down to the bedrock
Where no thing of consequence can grow
Drop your seeds there
Let them go
Awful atoll —
O, incalculable indiscreetness and sorrow!
Bawl bellow:
Sibyl sea-cow, all done up in a bow
Toddle and roll;
Teethe an impalpable bit of leather
While yarrow, heather and hollyhock
Awkwardly molt along the shore

hitchcock.line: There's a Greta Garbo and an Alfred Hitchcock
stanza: There's a Greta Garbo and an Alfred Hitchcock
And some black Jamaican stud
There's five Cinderellas and some leather drags
I almost fell into my mug
There's a Crawford, Davis and a tacky Cary Grant
And some Homeboys lookin' for trouble down here from the Bronx

sidewalk.line: I used to march down the windy, windy sidewalks
stanza: I used to march down the windy, windy sidewalks
Slapping my leg with a riding crop
Thinking it made me come off so tough
I didn't smile, because a smile always seemed rehearsed
I wasn't afraid of the bullies, and that just made the bullies worse

sidewalk.line: Looking at the cracks in the sidewalk
stanza: You walk down Alameda
Looking at the cracks in the sidewalk
Thinking about your friends
How you maintain all them in
A constant state of suspense
On the Sunday morning sidewalks
Wishing, Lord, that I was stoned
Cause there's something in a Sunday
That makes a body feel alone
And there's nothin' short of dyin'
Half as lonesome as the sound
On the sleepin' city sidewalks
Sunday mornin' comin' down

sidewalk.line: I’m out here spittin' on the sidewalk
stanza: Well tonight, I'm up in Chillicothe
Down-wind from the paper mill
I’m out here spittin' on the sidewalk
Taking in the factory smells
Head and nose, she tends to smokin' out the window
In the air, that gas pipe leak
I wonder if she’s cringing at the same time
Thinking pretty thoughts of me

sidewalk.line: She covered every last inch of the entire sidewalk
sidewalk.linePrev: Well, well, one year passed and believe it or not
sidewalk.lineNext: And she stopped, "Lucy, after all this, you're just giving in today?"

sidewalk.line: Amongst the scattered rubbish and suitcases on the sidewalk
stanza: People throwing dinars at the bellydancers
In a sad circus by a trench of burning oil
People throw belongings, a lifetime's earnings
Amongst the scattered rubbish and suitcases on the sidewalk

sidewalk.line: I am skipping on the sidewalk
stanza: I am cold against your skin
You are perfectly reflected
I am lost inside your pocket
I am lost against your fingers
I am falling down the stairs
I am skipping on the sidewalk
I am thrown against the sky
I am raining down in pieces
I am scattering like light
Scattering like light
Scattering like light

warlock.line: Swapped 20 on the spot and cop the warlock
warlock.linePrev: And probably hoarding 40 more in the corners of Fort Knox
warlock.lineNext: Back at the haunt, found God in the hamper
